environment.description: ASP.NET Core 6.0 service deployed on an EC2 instance in a public subnet. The service runs as a Docker container with host networking. The instance has an IAM role with S3 and SSM read access. The connection string in appsettings.json uses a static SQL Server password. The instance metadata service (IMDSv1) is enabled. No outbound network restrictions. The XML parsing endpoint is exposed directly via an Application Load Balancer with no managed rule groups attached.
